headline: Every pack checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
heroLede: With falafel, kibbeh, protein bars and contract work going through Campbellfield, every pack needs the right label and date for what is inside. Here's what a camera check could look like on your packing line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every pack is sealed straight across, with no crease and no crumbs caught in the seal. An open pack means a short shelf life and a complaint.
labelLede: A falafel pack and a kibbeh pack can look much the same at line speed, but kibbeh is usually made with wheat and meat, and falafel is often bought as a vegetarian choice. The camera checks every pack carries the right label for the run, straight and intact.
codeLede: The best-before and batch code has to be right and readable on every pack. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Film offcuts, glove pieces and loose parts can end up on the conveyor. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a carton.

vocab.alert: Four creased seals in fifteen minutes on Line 1. Check the pack sealer.
